datasheetOverview.section: MCT 88 overview - maximum capacity and tip loads by jib length
datasheetOverview.note: Page 1 of the 8-page local reference PDF (Potain-MCT-88_Reference.pdf, copyright 2026 Manitowoc). Shows 5 t maximum capacity, 53.1 m maximum jib, and the metric tip-load labels 20 m to 3.95 t through 53.1 m to 1.15 t.

datasheetLoadCharts.document: Potain MCT 88 Data Sheet, FEM 1.001-A3 (Manitowoc, Code 09-003-.5M-0610)
datasheetLoadCharts.note: Cycle 2 source note: imperial 98 ft row, upper line. 66 ft to 4.3 USt, 82 ft to 3.3 USt, 98 ft to 2.8 USt. The page number is ambiguous: the Cycle 2 mirrored copy records p. 3, while the local 8-page reference PDF places the metric load curves on p. 4. Neither page is treated as verified. This source is retained only for the Cycle 2 comparison in docs/SOURCES.md; no MCT 88 catalogue field references it, and the model keeps the p. 1 2.70 t label.

datasheetDimensions.document: Potain MCT 88 Data Sheet, FEM 1.001-A3 (Manitowoc, Code 09-003-.5M-0610)
datasheetDimensions.note: Page 6 of the 8-page local reference PDF. Counter-jib 4380 kg (variant A) / 4250 kg (variant B); cab 1100 kg; mast width 1.2 m; counter-jib length 11.9 m.

provenance.basis: Cycle 2 project model uses a nominal 30 m jib for validation. This is a project configuration default, not a manufacturer-recommended jib selection.

heaviestErectionComponent.name: Counter-jib
heaviestErectionComponent.note: Heaviest single component listed in the p. 6 dimensions and weight table: 4380 kg for variant A; variant B is 4250 kg. The table is a component-weight table, not an erection-sequence plan. Confirm the actual heaviest lift against the erection manual before use.

datasheetOverview.document: Potain MCT 85 F5 Data Sheet, FEM 1.001-A3 (Manitowoc, Ref. 02D_FEM1001mt_MCT85F5_2026_05-0)
datasheetOverview.section: MCT 85 F5 overview - maximum capacity and tip loads by jib length
datasheetOverview.note: PDF page 1 (the document has no printed page numbers; page references are PDF page indices). Local source PDF: plugins/tower-planner/docs/02D_FEM1001mt_MCT85F5_2026_05-0.pdf, 8 pages, (c) 2026 Manitowoc. Shows 5 t maximum capacity, 52 m maximum working jib (53.1 m is the overall tip length, not a working configuration), and metric tip-load labels 20 m to 3.95 t through 52 m to 1.1 t. The 30 m tip label is 2.5 t.

datasheetLoadCharts.document: Potain MCT 85 F5 Data Sheet, FEM 1.001-A3 (Manitowoc, Ref. 02D_FEM1001mt_MCT85F5_2026_05-0)
datasheetLoadCharts.note: PDF page 3. Per-radius load curves for jib lengths 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50 and 52 m. The printed minimum radius is 2.7 m; the first listed radius for each jib is the end of the 5 t plateau. The table is for the 5 t hook curve; the dashed 2.5 t-hook variant is 0.245 t lower beyond the changeover and is not modelled.

datasheetDimensions.document: Potain MCT 85 F5 Data Sheet, FEM 1.001-A3 (Manitowoc, Ref. 02D_FEM1001mt_MCT85F5_2026_05-0)
datasheetDimensions.section: Dimensions and weight - slewing crane part
datasheetDimensions.note: PDF page 5. Counter-jib variant A: 14.6 m, 4380 kg; variant B: 11.9 m, 4250 kg. The p. 1 drawing labels the counter-jib radius as 13.7 m (A) / 11.3 m (B); the table's L is the structural length. The catalogue uses variant A (longer, heavier) for the counter-jib length and heaviest component.

provenance.basis: Project default: 30 m is a published MCT 85 F5 jib configuration (p. 1 and p. 3) with a 2.5 t tip load, but the choice of a 30 m default is a project configuration, not a manufacturer recommendation.

heaviestErectionComponent.name: Counter-jib (variant A, with grab rail and platform)
heaviestErectionComponent.note: The p. 5 component-weight table lists 4380 kg for variant A and 4250 kg for variant B; variant A is the heavier and longer counter-jib. The table is a component-weight table, not an erection-sequence plan. The p. 1 drawing labels the counter-jib radius as 13.7 m (A) / 11.3 m (B), which is a different dimension from the table's structural length. Confirm the actual heaviest lift against the erection manual before use.
